snippet.title: Stick RPG 2 Director's Cut - Flash Game Full Playthrough
snippet.description:
Stick RPG 2 is the long awaited sequel to the original Stick RPG.  Now with the directors cut, the original world has had major improvements and a new map section added.  There's many more quests and secrets to find!

Back in the day this game was highly anticipated and constantly talked about on the Xgen Studios forums.  The speculation went on for so many years they eventually had to lock the category and it couldn't be talked about anymore.  There was always a huge amount of rumors about it and discussion about just how much code went into it.  Even then everyone loved talking about Stick RPG and every small bit about the game was uncovered.

This is basically a good playthrough of Stick RPG 2, covering all quests, secrets, and whatever else is possible.  I'll probably do an evil playthrough just to show that fun side.  It appears some of the trophies don't reward correctly now sadly.

▬▬ How to Play  ▬▬
There are still many good ways to play flash games.  Such as Flashpoint, the Y8 Browser, and Ruffle.
Y8 - https://www.y8.com/download-app
Flashpoint Infinity - https://flashpointarchive.org/downloads
